title: Easy to use, great waffles
text:
Easy to use, great waffles. I'm lazy and hate cleaning a waffle maker after use so this was was perfect! Was worried it would just be a gimmick and now work well but first time using it I made perfect waffles, no burnt or under done and a half cup measuring cup is perfect size to make perfect waffle with no overflow.
It did have a bad smell to it coming from the heating elements but it went away after a few waffles and didn't effect the food at all.
